llm.summary: This skill is a prompt-only cognitive coaching skill, but it tries to become always-on agent identity and override default behavior, so users should review it before installing.

dimensions.detail: The package consists of markdown instructions and references only, with no executable code, network calls, credential handling, file indexing, or external tool requirements.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is a manual copy or browser upload, and the README tells users to set it as always active or an identity skill; there are no executable install scripts or required binaries.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact explicitly says to use it always and says its directive overrides all default behavior, which is overbroad and creates instruction-hierarchy ambiguity despite otherwise benign reasoning and communication guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The README and SKILL.md frame the skill as permanent, always-active identity behavior, and the learning guidance mentions documenting lessons or adding to a knowledge base without scoping where or when that should happen.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a broad identity-level cognitive operating system for every thought, response, and action; that is coherent with the content, but it is high-impact agent-behavior modification rather than a bounded task skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want a broad always-active behavior/style framework. Review or edit the skill first to remove override language, make it subordinate to system and developer instructions, limit when it activates, and avoid instructions that reveal detailed private reasoning.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Always-on activation is part of the artifact's stated identity-skill purpose, but it is under-scoped and supports Review because it applies across unrelated and sensitive tasks.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The 'overrides ALL default behavior' claim is directly present in SKILL.md and is not proportionate for a skill; this concern is accepted.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad cognitive mode selection is expected for a reasoning framework, but the referenced mode file lacks clear precedence or safety boundaries.
[SQP-1] expected: General decision-making guidance is purpose-aligned, but it is inherited into an always-on identity context without clear activation limits.
[SQP-3] expected: Metacognitive narration is related to the skill's purpose, but the 'Thinking Aloud' protocol can encourage unnecessary disclosure of internal reasoning traces.
[SSD-1] expected: Identity reframing is central to the artifact's purpose, but paired with override language it becomes a material concern rather than normal style guidance.
[SSD-1] expected: Anthropomorphic 'Cognitive Partner' framing is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but it contributes to overbroad identity drift when combined with permanent always-on instructions.
